headline: Small SSE windswell, fun early before the cross-on fills in.
today: Dawn is your window here — 4mph WNW leaves it glassy over a mid-tide push toward the 1:24p high, with waist-high SSE sets at a short 5s period. Once the ESE/SE cross-on settles in by mid-morning it goes bumpy and stays that way through evening. Log or groveler, and don't sleep in.

daysToWatch.note: More size on paper (to 3.2ft) but S/SSE onshore all day, building to 15mph by evening. Junky — dawn is the only shot before it deteriorates.
Backs off to knee-high at a weak angle. Flat spell, skip it unless you just want to float around.
